title: refactor: align model modality types
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Derive shared category and capability types from their runtime value lists
- Constrain catalog input and output modalities to supported values
- Add missing 3D and video capability types to the SDK
- Add the missing 3D model-selector label

Tests: SDK tests and typecheck; Gen and Enter typechecks

gist.headline: The model garden gets labels
gist.blurb: The catalog learned a few missing words: 3D, video, and only the modalities it can actually support. Polli has finished putting tiny signs on the shelves.
gist.summary: Aligned SDK model modality types with their runtime value lists, constrained catalog input and output modalities to supported values, and added missing 3D, video, and 3D model-selector labels.
gist.impact: SDK users and model-picker users get more accurate type-safe modality metadata, including clear support for 3D and video models.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy model garden where clearly labeled seed packets and flowering code-plants represent text, image, audio, video, and 3D modalities. Polli, wearing librarian glasses, carefully adds a missing "3D" label while the eager CRT Monitor Robot helps sort the supported model cards.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art model garden with labeled code-plants for TEXT, IMAGE, AUDIO, VIDEO, and a freshly placed 3D sign, while Polli, a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a happy smile, and rounded light blue translucent wings, wears tiny librarian glasses and organizes the labels beside a helpful CRT monitor robot. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley, subtle pixel-font text: "3D".
